    <view wx:else class="notice">仅删除选中的这条回复；根回复、其他回复以及回复它的后续回复仍保留，后续回复中的原对象将显示为不可查看。</view>
    <view class="notice">仅删除时不会通知作者，不禁言，不扣除作者经验。当前没有恢复此内容的管理入口。已下载或正在展示的图片不会即时从所有设备消失。目标状态变化后需要重新确认。</view>

      <view>可选：对该内容的原作者同时处罚</view>

      <view>当前封号：{{management.punishmentOptions.access_suspension.current ? (management.punishmentOptions.access_suspension.current.endsAt || '永久') : '无生效处罚'}}</view>
      <radio-group bindchange="onPunishmentKind">
        <label><radio value="none" checked="{{punishmentKind === 'none'}}" disabled="{{busy}}"/>仅删除</label>

        <label><radio value="access_suspension" checked="{{punishmentKind === 'access_suspension'}}" disabled="{{busy}}"/>封号：限制大部分浏览和互动</label>
      </radio-group>
      <view wx:if="{{punishmentKind !== 'none'}}">
        <view>处罚只针对该内容的原作者。删除、处罚及两条私有通知一起生效；身份验证状态保持独立。原作者仍可查看处罚原因并申诉。</view>
        <radio-group bindchange="onPunishmentUnit">
          <label><radio value="minutes" checked="{{punishmentUnit === 'minutes'}}" disabled="{{busy}}"/>分钟</label>
          <label><radio value="hours" checked="{{punishmentUnit === 'hours'}}" disabled="{{busy}}"/>小时</label>
          <label><radio value="days" checked="{{punishmentUnit === 'days'}}" disabled="{{busy}}"/>天</label>
          <label><radio value="permanent" checked="{{punishmentUnit === 'permanent'}}" disabled="{{busy}}"/>永久</label>
        </radio-group>
        <input wx:if="{{punishmentUnit !== 'permanent'}}" type="number" value="{{punishmentValue}}" bindinput="onPunishmentValue" disabled="{{busy}}" placeholder="正整数时长"/>
        <textarea value="{{punishmentReason}}" bindinput="onPunishmentReason" disabled="{{busy}}" maxlength="255" placeholder="处罚原因（必填，最多255字）"/>
        <view>有限时长从本次生效时重新计算。同类永久处罚须先由超级管理员解除，不能直接缩短；另一类处罚独立保留。</view>
      </view>
    </view>
    <button class="primary destructive" bindtap="onSubmit" disabled="{{busy || frozen}}">确认删除{{management.target.kind === 'comment' ? '根回复' : '此回复'}}</button>
